senses.gloss:
Maskarin
------------------------------------------
The धर्मशास्त्रस् of various competent and scholarly ṛṣis or sages have guided the personal, social and religious lives of the Hindus for several centuries. गौतम is one such whose works like the Dharmasūtras have been held in high esteem. The sūtras, though containing a lot of information and instructions, being laconic, need bhāṣyas or commentaries to expound their contents.
The Bhāṣya of मस्करिन् (which is available in print and is quite extensive) on the Gautama Dharmasūtras has been respectfully quoted by several later writers of the dharmaśāstra digests.
Maskarin also quotes profusely from the works of his predecessors like उशनस्, कण्व, कात्यायन, पैठीनसि and Jātū-karṇi. He might have lived during the period A. D. 900-1100.
See also GAUTAMA.
